groups.defect: The membership actions require group_id although the routes supply id, and the controller specs conceal this mismatch by supplying group_id directly.
groups.rationale: Both report the same routing/controller parameter mismatch. The merged comment must retain the corrections to both controller actions and the specs that encode the mismatched parameter.

groups.defect: The totalPages calculation overcounts exact multiples of the page size, enabling navigation to an empty final page.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same floor-plus-one calculation and its pagination consequences. Additional offset clamping is a proposed safeguard, not a separately reported defect.
